correctness.rationale: The 28 vertices are exactly the noncollinear Fano triples; disjointness gives 42 edges, girth 7 and diameter 4. Independently regenerated all graph-power clique faces at radius 3, obtaining face vector (28,294,1456,3514,3864,1596,144), 10,896 nonempty simplices and 48,916 codimension-one face incidences. The specified 28-pivot matching pairs 5,404 faces and leaves one critical vertex plus 87 critical four-cells; a separate topological sort of the entire reversed-matched directed Hasse diagram visits all 10,896 faces, proving acyclicity rather than trusting a rank log. Forman Morse reduction gives a CW complex with only one zero-cell and 87 four-cells, hence wedge^87 S4 integrally. The graph has rank42−28+1=15 at r1, and Adamaszek Proposition 2.2 (girth≥7 for second power) gives r2 collapsibility to r1, corroborated by the 28 closed-neighborhood tetrahedral collapse structure. Diameter 4 gives a simplex at r4. Thus all real inclusive thresholds and the specified persistence bars follow, with no torsion claim based merely on mod-two ranks.
